description: Scrape product listings from Allegro.pl by search query, category URL, or direct offer URLs.

categoryUrl.description: Full Allegro category URL, e.g. https://allegro.pl/kategoria/laptopy-491 (mode=byCategory)
categoryUrl.title: Category URL

freeShippingOnly.description: If true, only include listings with free shipping.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free Shipping Only

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in PLN. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (PLN)

minPrice.description: Minimum price in PLN. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price (PLN)

mode.description: How to find products on Allegro.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. AUTO datacenter proxy is recommended to bypass anti-bot protection.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword(s) to search for on Allegro. (mode=search)
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: Sort order for search/category results. (mode=search, byCategory)
sortBy.title: Sort By

startUrls.description: List of Allegro offer URLs to scrape, e.g. https://allegro.pl/oferta/... (mode=byUrl)
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Allegro Scraper Input
